high_level_description: A single stylized cat in perched sitting pose, centered on a 1600x900 canvas with pale sky above and green grass below.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Two-tone background: pale sky occupying top 60% of canvas, grass occupying bottom 40%.

elements.desc: cat torso (rounded rectangle), warm brown, centered horizontally, spanning from y=300 to y=720
cat head (oval), warm brown, centered above torso
left front paw (ellipse), warm brown, positioned on grass near torso base
right front paw (ellipse), warm brown, symmetrically placed opposite left front paw
left hind paw (ellipse), warm brown, slightly smaller, tucked under rear torso
right hind paw (ellipse), warm brown, symmetrically placed opposite left hind paw
